description: Use this when the user wants what a stay really costs or whether it can be booked, at hotels already found, and before create_order. It returns live, bookable offers for up to 15 hotels and one stay. Every room in stay.rooms must have the same party: for different parties, call once per party. Each offer has the room type, the meals included, the total, in the request's currency, for the whole stay and every room (what is charged), with its average per room-night for comparison, fees payable at the property, the cancellation terms with times in UTC and the hotel's time zone, the confirmation mode, and an offerId for create_order with the time it expires. Hotels with nothing to offer are listed as unavailable with the reason. Up to limitPerHotel offers per hotel (default 15, fewer when the call's hotels share its 45 offers), picked to span price, free cancellation, breakfast and rooms, listed cheapest first; the answer says, per hotel, how many more a call for that hotel alone would show.

currency.description: The currency of every price: USD (default) or CNY. Each currency is paid through its own channel, with its own payment methods; the order's payment page shows them. CNY is paid through payment channels in mainland China and suits a user who pays that way. An order made from these offers is charged in this currency.

requireBreakfast.description: Keep only offers that include breakfast.

requireFreeCancellation.description: Keep only offers that can still be cancelled free of charge.

hotelIds.description: Hotels to price, 1 to 15, no repeats.

limitPerHotel.description: Offers per hotel, 1 to 30. Left out: 15 for each hotel that has offers while that is at most 45 offers in all, otherwise 45 split evenly among those hotels (5 hotels: 9 each; 15 hotels: 3 each). Given: that many for each hotel while that is at most 100 offers in all, otherwise 100 split evenly the same way. The answer says, for each hotel, how many more offers a call for that hotel alone would show.

locale.description: Language for names and text in the response: en or zh.

stay.description: Dates and party. One party per call: every room must be the same.

checkIn.description: Check-in date in the hotel's calendar, yyyy-MM-dd.

checkOut.description: Check-out date in the hotel's calendar, yyyy-MM-dd. Stays are 1 to 15 nights; a longer one answers stay_unsupported (max_nights), and past 30 nights invalid_request: ask the user whether to split it into consecutive stays.

rooms.description: The rooms wanted, 1 to 8, each with its party; offers and orders need every room the same.

childrenAges.description: Age of each child in this room, 0 to 17. An empty list means no children.

name: get_hotel_offers
title: Live offers
